conviction_note: Event confirmed for 4 Nov 08:30 EET. Nothing unpriced and company-level turned up: the bar is a Modular Finance consensus from 16 contributors (UW EUR 426m, CR 82.79%, op EPS 0.14), every one updated after Tryg's and Gjensidige's benign Q3s. The leans are small and positive: peers' weather and large-loss read-through, a habitual narrowing of the guide, and a possible NOBA-funded buyback that the local analyst does not expect until the 17 Nov Investor Update. That gives p_up 55 on a 3.5% scale, so +0.35, close to the +0.45 sum of the findings. Both measurements are mild for the same reason: the Investor Update after the window is where the new targets and capital return are expected to land.

findings.finding: Both direct Nordic P&C peers printed benign Q3 2026 claims: Tryg CR 76.8% (78.6%), weather 0.8% (2.0%), 'benign levels of large and weather claims', strong Sweden and Norway; Gjensidige CR 73.6% (79.7%). Sampo's consensus CR of 82.79% assumes only ~0.2pt improvement on Q3'25's 83.0%, which leans toward an underwriting beat for If's Nordic book.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Observed reactions on Sampo's actual report dates (Yahoo closes): Q3'23 +3.18%, Q3'24 0.00%, Q3'25 -0.08% (a solid Q3 with an expected buyback, flat). Last 12 prints: median absolute 2.7%, 8 of 12 up. Q2'26 UW beat plus outlook raise: +1.16%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The consensus was compiled on 30 Oct and every contributor was 'updated or confirmed' after both peer prints, yet it still sits only 0.2pt better than last year, while Tryg improved 1.8pt and Gjensidige 6.1pt. Fully priced would mean a consensus CR near 81-82%. Against that: Sampo pre-flagged two large claims (Baltics, Norway), Hastings (UK motor) does not share Nordic weather, and Inderes sits BELOW consensus at UW 416. So this is a proxy, sized small.
findings.independence: Gjensidige Q3 2026, CR 73.6% vs 79.7%, a separate company: https://quartr.com/events/gjensidige-gjf-q3-2026_33xa1w2n

findings.finding: The FY UW guide is EUR 1,550-1,625m, H1 actual is 786 and Q3 consensus is 426, so 9M lands around 1,212 and FY consensus at 1,605. That is the upper half, and Sampo habitually tweaks its guide each quarter (raised revenue at Q1, raised the UW low end at Q2), so a narrowing toward 1,590-1,625 is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1'26 outlook raise +2.15%; Q2'26 outlook raise/narrowing +1.16%.
findings.original_quote: Sampo saattaa tuttuun tyyliin tarkentaa hieman ohjeistustaan. Yhtiö on ohjeistanut vakuutusmaksutuottojen olevan 9,7-9,85 miljardia euroa ja underwriting-tuloksen 1550-1625 MEUR. Ennen tulosta konsensuksen odotukset ovat: 9767 MEUR ja 1605 MEUR. [Sampo may, in its familiar style, slightly specify its guidance... consensus expectations before the result: 9,767 MEUR and 1,605 MEUR.]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the consensus already sits in the upper half of the guide. A narrowing only confirms what the market is holding, so it is sized near 0. A mismatch (holding the range or trimming the top) would be the surprise, and nothing points to one.
findings.independence: Sampo's Q2 release, showing the prior guide changes and H1 UW of 786: https://www.inderes.fi/releases/sampo-groups-results-for-january-june-2026

baseline_tension: The baseline lean (-0.43, all run-up) points mildly down. What was found reads the +8.5% run-up as a rebound from the EUR 9.00 Solidium placing plus the peers' read-through, not crowding, and the findings lean mildly up. The disagreement is small because the peer read-through is already in the 30 Oct consensus.
language_note: The Inderes Finnish Q3 preview (2 Nov) carried things the English sources did not: the consensus range (UW 407-440, PBT 41-479), Inderes' own UW of 416 BELOW consensus, the note that Sampo had pre-flagged two larger claims (Baltics and Norway), the FY consensus of 9,767 / 1,605 against the guide, and an explicit expectation of no buyback or synergy update until 17 Nov.

Solidium's own Finnish release (STT Info) gave the EUR 9.00 placing price and the 90-day lock-up wording. Inderes' Finnish 'Kättä alle' note (24 Sep) attributed the September weakness to Solidium's funding needs plus rate rises and US AI fears around insurers.
Sampo's own filings are bilingual (FI/EN/SV), so the filing record added nothing language-specific.
lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 3.0 to 3.5. The release can carry a guidance narrowing and an optional buyback, and the name's observed print median is 2.7% (not the baseline's 1.45%).
'A narrow proxy loses... macro-to-company transmission is a hypothesis': the peer read-through finding cut from +0.4 to +0.3. Peers are not counterparties, and Sampo pre-flagged its own large claims.
'A finding that lands inside what the company already guided': the guidance-narrowing finding cut from +0.2 to +0.1, because the consensus already sits in the upper half of the range.
'Keep findings inside the exit window': confirmed the Investor Update (17 Nov) and the lock-up expiry stay in outside_window.
